subject: Next steps & MAP: FinPay pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@finpay.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinPay discovery — post-call recap & proposed MAP

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and appreciate the clarity on success criteria. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

Key decision criteria you mentioned:
- Latency and per-token cost for high-concurrency customer chats
- Integrations with existing SSO and audit logging
- Clear SLAs and data residency for regulated transactions

Stakeholder map (from today):
- Economic sponsor: Lydia Chan (VP Product) — final sign-off
- Procurement: Rajiv Singh (Procurement Lead) — PO/contract
- Security: Anika Rao (InfoSec) — questionnaire and evidence
- Legal: procurement@finpay.com (contracts)

Proposed MAP milestones (timeline is flexible — please flag conflicts):
1) Security questionnaire & initial evidence — target 2027-07-02 (Anika/Rishi to confirm)
2) Procurement checklist review & LOE estimate for pilot — target 2027-07-09 (Rajiv + Marissa)
3) Pilot scope and SOW sign-off / PO submission — target 2027-07-16
4) Pilot kickoff (2-week pilot) — target 2027-07-20
5) Exec review & final decision — target 2027-08-05

I've attached a draft MAP (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps owners and deliverables. Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders above and whether the timeline looks reasonable? Also please share the procurement checklist/any contracting constraints — I can sync legal here as needed.

Next steps from my side:
- Share MAP doc (attached) and update with your stakeholder contacts
- Rishi to own SOC2/Security artifacts request (cc'd)
- Camila to prepare pilot SOW and high-level resource plan

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@finpay.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@finpay.com>, procurement@finpay.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPay discovery — post-call recap & proposed MAP

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and proposed dates. This aligns with our internal expectations; a few notes/questions: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: I'm the economic sponsor and will drive the exec review. Rajiv will handle procurement logistics; Anika will own security review. I'll loop our legal (procurement@finpay.com) for contract terms.
- Security: we need to confirm SSO (SAML/Okta) support and what logging/audit events you store and for how long. Can Rishi provide a short summary we can share with InfoSec?
- Procurement: attaching our procurement checklist for your reference. There are a couple standard clauses (data retention, indemnity cap) our legal will want to review — hope that's OK.

On timelines: the 7/2 security checkpoint works if we can get the questionnaire and evidence by then. Procurement may need an extra week for redlines, so LOE review by 7/9 is fine.

Attachment: Procurement_Checklist_2306.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I'll confirm exec availability for early August.

— Lydia
Lydia Chan
VP Product, FinPay
lydia.chan@finpay.com

Subject: Re: FinPay discovery — post-call recap & proposed MAP

Thanks Lydia — appreciate the checklist. Quick internal update and owners: 

- Rishi: I'll assign you the security questionnaire and SOC2 artifacts. Can you produce the one-page summary Lydia asked for (SSO support + logging retention) by EOD 7/1 so InfoSec has something to review?
- Marissa: I'll draft the pilot SOW and LOE (high-level) and share a versioned MAP (attached FinPay_MAP_v2.xlsx) that incorporates procurement checkpoints and legal review items.
- Marissa/Rajiv: I'll slot time next week to walk through the procurement checklist and flag any standard negotiation points.

Marissa — attached updated MAP with owners and dates adjusted to reflect Lydia's procurement note. If anyone sees a timing issue please call it out and we can adjust.

> On Fri, 25 Jun 2027 at 16:05, Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@finpay.com> wrote:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@finpay.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika.rao@finpay.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPay discovery — post-call recap & proposed MAP

Thanks — happy to own security artifacts. Quick status and ask: 

Status:
- Redwood supports SAML/Okta SSO for both hosted and private deployments; we can provide a SAML metadata file and SP-initiated flow details.
- Audit/logging: we persist request-level logs and event-level audit logs. Default retention 90 days for hosted; for Dedicated/Private we can accommodate customer retention policies via config and KMS integration.
- SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 Type II report excerpt for relevant controls and a current compliance matrix.

Deliverables I'll provide by 2027-07-02:
1) One-page SSO + logging summary (for InfoSec)
2) SOC2 excerpt + compliance matrix (redacted where appropriate)
3) List of any demo/scale test access I'll need from FinPay (sample dataset access, test Okta tenant details)

Ask from FinPay:
- Please provide a contact for your IdP admin (SAML metadata endpoint or sample metadata file) and a primary InfoSec reviewer so I can tailor the evidence packages.

I'll upload the artifacts to the shared HubSpot/Deal link once ready.

— Rishi
Security Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
